Our approach

A container is only a structure. A home is everything you decide to build inside it.

We design and build container homes and modular living spaces. Every project starts with the site, the way you live and the details that matter to you, then the steel shell is shaped to fit.

Layout, light, materials and finishes are decided together, so the finished home feels considered rather than assembled.

The process

From first idea to handover.

01 / 04
  1. 01

    Consultation & design

    We start with your brief and your site: how you want to live, the views, the light and the access. The layout, openings and finishes are developed around them.

  2. 02

    The steel structure

    The containers are prepared and positioned, with openings cut for doors and windows, and the structure is established on site.

  3. 03

    Interior build-out

    Inside, the shell is framed and insulated, then services, lining and joinery are added until it begins to feel like a home.

  4. 04

    Finishing & handover

    Final finishes, lighting and landscaping bring the project together, and the completed home is handed over ready to live in.

Stages and sequence vary by project.

Why container homes

A different way to build.

A container home is not the right answer for everyone. For the right brief and the right site, it offers qualities that are hard to find elsewhere.

i.

Design flexibility

Containers can be combined, stacked and cantilevered, which opens up bold forms and layouts that respond to the site.

ii.

Efficient use of space

A modular footprint encourages careful planning, so every square metre is used with purpose.

iii.

Made to your brief

Layouts, glazing, materials and finishes are specified together, so the home reflects how you live.

iv.

A contemporary character

Industrial structure paired with warm interiors gives a look that is distinctly modern and unmistakably yours.

About

Considered design, built with care.

We specialise in container homes and modular living. Our work combines architectural thinking with hands-on building, from the first sketch to the finished interior.

Questions

Before you begin.

Can the home be customised?

Yes. Every project begins with your brief, and layout, glazing, materials and finishes are developed around it.

What interior and exterior finishes can I choose?

Our completed homes feature finishes such as timber-slat walls, textured tile, oak worktops and marble-effect paving.

How does project planning work?

We begin with a conversation about your brief and your site, then develop the design with you before construction starts.

How is pricing worked out?

Cost depends on size, specification, site conditions and finishes, so we provide a quotation once we have reviewed your brief.

How do I get started?

Give us a call on 96617880 and we will talk through your project and the next steps.
